channels.clickToCorrect: Click a resource to manually correct metadata
channels.episodeReconciled: Episode number converted from absolute to per-season using metadata evidence.
channels.episodeAmbiguousTip: Episode number is ambiguous. Confirm via the Suggestions panel before download.
channels.validFeed: Valid RSS: {count} entries, {torrent} with download links
channels.fieldMappingDesc: Define how to extract structured fields from RSS entries

channels.noMapping: No field mapping generated, please check LLM configuration
channels.mappingRequired: Field mapping is required. Complete AI analysis or manually enter JSON
channels.rssValidationFailed: RSS URL validation failed, fix before submitting
channels.metadataLLMDesc: When local matching fails, Metadata Agent searches the configured source and uses LLM reasoning to resolve work metadata. May add fetch delay.
channels.metadataSourceDesc: External data source the Metadata Agent uses to search work metadata. Only enabled and configured sources are shown.
channels.metadataSourceNoneDesc: No external data source is enabled and configured. Set the relevant API key in .env and keep its switch on, or turn off metadata search to use local matching only.
channels.autoCleanupUnresolvedDesc: When enabled, FileResources that remain unresolved past the threshold and have had no manual handling (direct download or metadata edit) are deleted automatically; if the feed re-publishes the same item it is re-created and re-matched.
channels.defaultIsAnimeDesc: When enabled, works matched/created from this channel default to is_anime = true
channels.defaultIsAnimeLocked: Cannot be changed after channel creation
channels.cleanupThresholdDaysDesc: Unresolved resources older than this (by creation time) are cleaned up. Range 1-365, default 21 (3 weeks).
channels.metadataFallbackDesc: When the primary source finds no match, Exa searches these sites in order for identity info (identity/links only — content still follows the primary source)
channels.metadataFallbackHelper: Earlier entries win; clear all to disable the Exa fallback
channels.metadataLLMOn: When local matching fails, Metadata Agent will search for work metadata
channels.metadataLLMOff: When disabled, new works will not be automatically searched
channels.titleCleanNone: None – use raw title for matching
channels.titleCleanRegex: Regex – custom regex to extract core title
channels.regexPattern: Regex pattern, must include capture group 1
channels.regexHint: First capture group will be used as search title
channels.aiPromptHint: After AI analysis, mapping will be auto-filled. You can also edit JSON manually.
channels.validateFirst: Please validate the RSS URL first, then use "AI Analyze" to generate field mapping
channels.noMappingYet: No field mapping yet, click "AI Analyze" to generate
channels.mappingMandatoryDesc: Without field mapping, the system cannot parse RSS entries and will not download any resources.
channels.requiredFieldsDesc: Declare this channel's required metadata fields (covering every filter DSL field, grouped by work type first, then semantic category): the resource list shows them, and agent filter DSL may only pick these fields (pick preferences are exempt). The list is add-only after creation; base and shape-scoped required fields are code-enforced and cannot be removed.
channels.columnSettingsHint: Toggle columns and reorder; saved per channel in this browser.
channels.requiredFieldsLockedHint: System-required: enforced by code per base/shape tier, cannot be removed
channels.requiredFieldsSavedHint: Previously saved: add-only, cannot be removed

agents.title: Download Agents
agents.deleteWarning: Related download tasks will be marked as cancelled. This action cannot be undone.
agents.runImmediatelyHint: After saving, trigger one background Agent run that fetches every channel resource matching the subscription rules since the channel was created (already-downloaded episodes are skipped).
agents.subdirHint: Relative path, must not contain .. or absolute paths
agents.scopeChannelWideDesc: Channel-wide mode: Filters all linked metadata resources from the entire channel. Works scope is ignored.
agents.scopeWorksDesc: Selected works mode: Only processes subscribed works. Works scope is effective.
agents.globalFilterDesc: All resources must pass these conditions. Work-level filters are merged with AND.
agents.worksRequired: At least 1 subscribed work is required in non-channel-wide mode
agents.ambiguousHint: Episode/season is ambiguous — confirm the season and per-season episode to dispatch.
agents.previewDesc: These channel resources now match your subscription rules. Select which to add to the download queue. Resources already tasked or no longer matching are excluded; in-queue tasks are never revoked.
agents.previewNoLongerHint: These resources matched the old rules but not the new ones. Tasks already in the queue are left untouched.
agents.runNowHint: Processes only resources fetched since the last run. To backfill history, edit the subscription rules.
agents.runSinceHint: Scan resources ingested since a chosen start time, or scan the entire history (no limit). The watermark still advances after the run.
agents.runSinceModeSince: From a specific time (default: 14 days ago)
agents.runSinceNotice: Scans all resources ingested since the start time and dispatches matching episodes not yet downloaded; episodes with existing tasks are skipped. A long channel history may take significantly longer.
agents.aiHandled: AI picked a candidate and dispatched it.
agents.aiHandleFailed: AI could not decide. Please confirm manually.
agents.batchRetryAllConfirm: Retry all failed/paused tasks of this agent?
agents.dedupInfoTitle: Built-in dedup logic (runs automatically before the LLM pick)
agents.pickPreferencesDesc: When several versions of the same episode/work appear, candidates are compared rule by rule in order: matches win, ties continue to the next rule. A unique winner is picked directly (no LLM call); a remaining tie goes to the LLM prompt below. Preferences only rank candidates — they never filter them out.
agents.dedupTvDesc: Multiple releases of the same series/season/episode are duplicates: if this agent already has an active or completed task for that episode, new releases are skipped (per-work episode dedup can be turned off); when several versions appear in one run, the conflict-resolution setting applies — auto: the LLM picks using the prompt below with no download decision created (falls back to built-in rules: resolution > file size > publish date); ask: a download decision is created for manual selection.
agents.dedupMovieDesc: Any re-release of the same movie is a duplicate: skipped when an active or completed task exists; multiple versions in one run follow the same conflict resolution as episodes.
agents.dedupBatchDesc: Dedup is based on content coverage: season packs by series + season, multi-season packs by series + season set, movie packs by movie. Only versions with identical coverage enter the same conflict resolution as episodes; differing or undeterminable coverage is dispatched independently without dedup. Franchise packs are not auto-dispatched.
agents.llmPromptHint: Tells the LLM how to choose among multiple candidates. Leave empty to use the default: prefer most-complete metadata, highest resolution, subtitles, newest.
agents.llmPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Prefer HEVC 10-bit releases from LoliHouse; avoid torrents over 5GB.
agents.runControlDesc: Manually trigger agent to process new resources in the channel immediately
agents.worksEditNote: Add, remove, and per-work filter changes are committed together when you click Save.
agents.deleteTaskWarning: Downloaded data will not be deleted by default. Check "Delete data" to also remove files.
agents.webhookUrlInvalid: Please enter a valid http/https URL
agents.webhookDeleteConfirm: Delete this webhook? It will no longer receive download notifications.
agents.notifRegeneratePlaceholder: Leave empty to check from the earliest completed task
agents.notifBulkRetrySince: Only notifications updated after this time (optional)
agents.filterFieldsGated: This channel declares required metadata fields: filter conditions may only use those fields (pick preferences are exempt).

downloaders.mockDescription: Mock downloader — accepts every task, no real network activity. Each task completes after a random 1–10s delay. Use for exercising the Agent flow without a real Transmission daemon.

downloaders.volumeExtra: When bound, the download root resolves to volume mount path + subpath; leave empty when the downloader and this process see identical paths
downloaders.volumeSubpathExtra: Relative path; editable only when a volume is selected
downloaders.volumeSubpathInvalid: Must be a relative path without empty, '.' or '..' segments

volumes.mountPathExtra: Absolute path inside the container; mount the host storage here at compose time
